## Summary
Satwik Kanhere is a full-stack software developer specializing in Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA backends and React.js, Next.js, TypeScript frontends for enterprise B2B commerce. Production work includes CRM Kanban, Product Information Management (PIM), Ag-Grid Server-Side Row Model tables, payment integrations (eBizCharge, Finix, ACH, CyberSource), and CDN performance with GCP and Cloudflare.
